criteria.description: Configurable control family — every declared (SemanticControlKind, PresentationRole) pair resolves to exactly one ComponentControl, and every control is reachable by at least one pair.
criteria.evidence: tests/component_composition.rs::selection_is_total_over_kind_and_role_with_every_control_reachable, plus ::every_drivable_pair_paints_through_the_production_render_path. control_for is one exhaustive match on the tuple with no `_` arm; 28 pairs, 25 resolving to a control and 3 to an explicit typed refusal. WP01's review verified the compile-error property in both directions: a fifth PresentationRole and an eighth SemanticControlKind each produce E0004 naming the uncovered pairs.
criteria.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
criteria.notes: 18 of the 25 askable pairs are drivable with production-projected data; Stepped and Surface are production-unprojected, so the remaining 7 are named and pinned rather than covered by a fabricated view model. The projected-kind set is asserted exactly, so a change forces the sweep to be revisited.

criteria.description: Product control shapes — parameter rows, choice rows, toggles, compact sliders, faders, meters, browser rows, and modal options render as their designed shapes.
criteria.evidence: All eight controls exist as separate modules under src/shell/visual/controls/ and are reached only through control_for. tests/component_composition.rs::every_drivable_pair_paints_through_the_production_render_path asserts each paints. research.md R-02 compliance verified by review: no egui::Slider, ProgressBar, Checkbox, or SelectableLabel is used for appearance anywhere.
criteria.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
criteria.notes: Three shapes have NO authored Figma specimen and ship as flagged minimums: the toggle, the choice-row adjacency affordance, and the meter. Confirmed absent by two independent node-type censuses of the whole Screens page. Recorded as F-01; this is an open product decision, not an implementation gap.

criteria.description: Nine-state rendering per control — every applicable ComponentState carries both its authored color treatment and its authored NonColorSignal.
criteria.evidence: tests/component_composition.rs::every_control_paints_every_applicable_state_without_relying_on_color. Each control additionally carries a pairwise assertion that no two applicable states produce identical evidence with color excluded. Mutation-verified by WP03's reviewer: stripping Selected's non-color evidence failed all four pairwise assertions by name.
criteria.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
criteria.notes: Applicability is declared per control rather than assumed over the full cross product, and a non-applicable state is declared rather than merely absent.

criteria.description: Reusable composition family — the shell regions are available as shared compositions.
criteria.evidence: tests/component_composition.rs::every_shipped_region_is_produced_by_a_declared_composition. ShellComposition is closed at eight and exhaustively matched at region(); adding a variant is a compile error.
criteria.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
criteria.notes: The family grew from seven to eight mid-mission. Implementation proved it incomplete: paint_mixer_workspace landed nowhere, because a Section at VerticalStrip is one track column and nothing composed the bank of sixteen. The crest-spec was amended first (MixerStripBank), then WP09 derived from it. The cheaper alternative — a layout axis on Section — was tested and rejected: Section's entries are typed &[SemanticControlViewModel], i.e. controls, while a bank's entries are columns, and a column is itself a Section.

criteria.description: The production shell composes from the library.
criteria.evidence: tests/component_composition.rs::every_shipped_region_is_produced_by_a_declared_composition drives the real EframeGraphicalApplication::update. paint_shell iterates application_shell::frame_plan_for, builds the panel each placement names, and hands the band to arrange_band.
criteria.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
criteria.notes: Verified by eye as well as by test: the orchestrator ran the app at both contexts and confirmed the frame is composed, all sixteen mixer columns seat with no scroll, and the track cards are gone.

criteria.description: The render adapter holds no visual decisions.
criteria.evidence: tests/component_composition.rs::no_visual_decision_survives_outside_the_visual_module, with three supporting tests proving the guard reads the delivered tree, reports a planted decision, and allows what the vocabulary permits. Mutation-verified: a Color32::from_rgb planted in the adapter and, separately, in src/testing/component_gallery_scene.rs each fail the same test by file and line.
criteria.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
criteria.notes: The guard is repo-wide in FILE coverage (130 sources, 82,372 lines, exactly one excluded subtree) but not in CONSTRUCT coverage: Vec2::new, vec2(), and a bare f32 band extent are not yet needles. The tree is clean of those forms today — verified by grep across src/ — so this is a completeness gap, not a concealed violation.

criteria.description: The gallery covers controls and compositions.
criteria.evidence: Fifteen gallery pages: 8 vocabulary + 4 control pages + 3 composition pages, with MixerStripBank joining the existing StripPanelAndFooter page. tests/component_vocabulary.rs asserts coverage as exact set equality over ALL_COMPONENT_CONTROLS and ALL_SHELL_COMPOSITIONS.
criteria.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
criteria.notes: Set equality, not a count: WP07's reviewer confirmed that skipping the Toggle fails with left={7 controls} vs right={8}, the identical failure a ninth declared variant with no specimen would produce.

criteria.description: Coverage assertion over the closed unions.
criteria.evidence: The coverage assertion is generic over the declared families rather than a hardcoded total, so a ninth variant fails rather than passing at 8-of-9. Mutation-verified by WP07's reviewer: removing one painted specimen drops the coverage counts and fails by name.
criteria.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
criteria.notes: This form was chosen deliberately over a count. F-14 records why: in this mission a count failed to catch a hairline moved to the wrong position, and a containment check passed a fabricated value.

criteria.evidence: tests/component_composition.rs::no_component_owns_caches_or_dispatches_application_state. The check has a source half and a runtime half that are independent: an AtomicU32 render counter, deliberately absent from the source guard's needle list, was caught by the runtime half alone ('ParameterRow paints differently on a second identical render').
criteria.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
criteria.notes: The runtime half currently covers controls but not compositions. Recorded for mission review.

criteria.description: Both viewports resolve from declared density policies.
criteria.evidence: tests/component_composition.rs::both_authored_viewports_survive_recomposition. Every band height, split, inset, and the mixer column geometry resolve through ViewportDensityPolicy; no composition or control reads a raw viewport size.
criteria.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
criteria.notes: WP09 added ViewportDensityPolicy::mixer_column() so the adapter's invented MIXER_TRACK_MIN_WIDTH_PX = 176.0 could be deleted rather than relocated.

criteria.evidence: Each control and composition was authored against its Figma specimen and reviewed against the live design file, not against a report. The load-bearing measurement was independently re-verified twice: node 42:25 holds sixteen Fader instances at width 82, pitch 86, gutter 4, inside 1452 px of content, so 15x86+82 = 1372 <= 1452.
criteria.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
criteria.notes: That measurement retired a real shipped defect: MIXER_TRACK_MIN_WIDTH_PX = 176.0 is 2.15x the authored width, and 16x176 = 2816 > 1500 was the only reason the horizontal ScrollArea existed. It was compensating for an invented constant, not carrying load. DESIGN.md:462 requires all sixteen faders visible at 1920x1080; they now are. Remaining divergences are recorded (F-11) and are cleanup, not gates, per operator direction.

criteria.description: Additive gallery page vocabulary — Phase 4a's eight pages and their digit bindings preserved exactly.
criteria.evidence: T037's frozen baseline pins the eight pre-existing digit bindings. Mutation-verified by WP07's reviewer: swapping Digit3 and Digit4 fails exactly ONE test, the frozen-baseline one — the ordered-equality signature. A containment check would have passed it.
criteria.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
criteria.notes: Four keys were added (Digit9, Digit0, BracketLeft, BracketRight) with the WindowInput descriptor count moving 33 to 41 in the same change, as the invariant requires.

criteria.description: DESIGN.md names all nine non-color-signalled states.
criteria.evidence: DESIGN.md:576 previously named six states while ComponentState has held nine since Phase 4a. Corrected in WP08 (T046).
criteria.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
criteria.notes: This was finding A10 of the Phase 4a analysis report, folded in under DIRECTIVE_025 rather than filed away.

criteria.evidence: ROADMAP.md's component-library demo bullet is amended in place to state what Phase 4 actually delivered: a hand-browsable gallery, no MIDI fixture, no audio.
criteria.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
criteria.notes: WP08 deliberately did NOT amend the program-level 'live-demo requirement for every phase' rule from inside one phase's entry, recording the contradiction instead. Its reviewer ruled that restraint correct, noting the cross-reference is one-directional and one pointer line at ROADMAP.md:9-20 would close it.

negative_invariants.description: No MIDI, no audio anywhere in this slice.
negative_invariants.evidence: The component demo scene constructs no audio output and no MIDI event source, so running it plays nothing. No audio device is opened and no MIDI fixture is loaded.
negative_invariants.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
negative_invariants.notes: SCOPE CORRECTION (operator, 2026-08-03): an earlier reading of this mission inflated 'no sound in the UI' into a measured, provable silence property with witness predicates and source-scan derivations. That escalation was the orchestrator's and is exactly the proof-about-proof layer C-007 forbids. What is required is that the scene plays nothing; no proof of silence is owed.

negative_invariants.description: No new semantic vocabulary: no SemanticAction variant, no focus target, no reducer behavior.
negative_invariants.evidence: tests/component_composition.rs::no_component_owns_caches_or_dispatches_application_state asserts no control or composition dispatches a SemanticAction; ControlIntent is returned and never converted inside the visual module.
negative_invariants.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
negative_invariants.notes: Four WindowInput key variants were added, which are normalized physical keys rather than semantic vocabulary. Two gaps were declared rather than closed by extending the projection: T009's choice-boundary criterion (F-05) and the mixer meter's level (F-10 item 9).

negative_invariants.description: No invented values in the production shell — omit or mark explicitly unavailable, never fabricate.
negative_invariants.evidence: tests/component_composition.rs::a_composition_with_no_view_data_marks_the_gap_rather_than_painting_one. mark_unavailable paints the declared marker plus the missing structure's name, never an empty string or a zero. Mutation-verified: painting '0.000' for the mark fails by name.
negative_invariants.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
negative_invariants.notes: Visible in the shipped product: the PATCH Utility panel renders MASTER VOLUME, MIDI INPUT and VOICE LIMIT as the declared unavailable marker. T027 (F-10) records the ten designed structures the projection does not drive; that list is Phase 5's declared input.

negative_invariants.description: Closed unions stay closed and exhaustively matched.
negative_invariants.evidence: Every family is a closed enum matched exhaustively with no `_` arm. Proven at merge rather than only by test: adding MixerStripBank produced E0004 at application_shell.rs:422, naming the site that had to change.
negative_invariants.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
negative_invariants.notes: The same property retired both scaffold stubs. paints_nothing and arranges_nothing each became unreachable once every arm resolved to a real module, failing clippy -D warnings on dead code at the cross-lane merge — a result no single lane could observe.

negative_invariants.description: Crest owns the component API; third-party egui utilities may be used underneath.
negative_invariants.evidence: research.md R-02 is enforced: everything paints through Painter over an allocated Response. No egui::Slider, ProgressBar, Checkbox, or SelectableLabel is used for appearance, verified by grep in every control review.
negative_invariants.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
negative_invariants.notes: The reason is NFR-004: a styled egui widget hides a visual literal inside egui::Style, where the guard cannot see it.

negative_invariants.evidence: The eight pre-existing gallery pages and their digit bindings are pinned by T037's frozen baseline. Tokens, typeface, density policies, and primitives were consumed, not revised.
negative_invariants.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
negative_invariants.notes: ViewportDensityPolicy gained mixer_column(), which is additive and was declared in the crest-spec before the code existed.

negative_invariants.description: No mission-artifact proof work — this mission proves the library exists and is used, and builds no layer that verifies the verification.
negative_invariants.evidence: The acceptance target contains no check of another check. The words 'silence', 'audible', and 'audioOrMidiConstructed' do not appear in it.
negative_invariants.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
negative_invariants.notes: C-007 was breached once during the mission, by the orchestrator, in the form of the invented silence-proof requirement. It was retracted before WP08 was dispatched and no proof-about-proof layer shipped.

negative_invariants.description: The existing suite passes with zero failures and no existing shell, projection, or focus test modified to accommodate this mission.
negative_invariants.evidence: 893 passed / 0 failed / 1 ignored on the final lane, against a baseline measured by stashing. tests/component_vocabulary.rs is the one existing test file this mission may modify, sanctioned by T045 because the crest-spec deliberately changed the rule it encodes; WP07's reviewer proved the edit forced by restoring the mission-branch copy and getting two hard type errors (E0308, E0277) plus a runtime assert made false by the fifteen-variant page union.
negative_invariants.verified_by: claude (orchestrator), on evidence re-run independently by each work package's reviewer
negative_invariants.notes: The 1 ignored test is a deliberate forward-looking tripwire asserting what should become true when an unowned fixture is repaired.
